description: Use this when you already have a resource_id and need the list price, floor, volume tiers, and URL. Optional quantity from 1 to 100 returns that quantity's unit price and total, with the same volume discount as negotiate_price. Required input: resource_id from search_resources. Returns the quote, including list and floor. When the seller wrote one, the quote includes description. Does not change the price or pay.

quantity.description: Optional number of paid accesses, from 1 to 100. Defaults to 1. The unit price includes the volume discount.

resource_id.description: Required. Resource id returned by search_resources.

name: get_quote
title: Get quote
